description.narrative: Leap India Food & Logistics Private Limited (Leap India or Sponsor) is a leading Indian company specializing in modern agricultural warehousing and logistics. With over 30% market share in India, it is developing a national network of agri-storage silos under the Food Corporation of India (FCI)s Public Private Partnership (PPP) program. The project entails the construction of scientific storage silos with a total capacity of 1.725 million metric tonnes (MMT), under a 32.25-year PPP concession with the FCI.

The Project is expected to improve access to modern logistics infrastructure for agricultural commodities in India and reduce food loss resulting in lower greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. At the market level, the Project is expected to enhance the competitiveness of the agriculture supply chain by scaling efficient logistics solutions to serve Indias national food schemes, leading to enhanced food security.
